subject: Clearline case study: SOC 2 language and logo usage
messages:
From: Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alexis Morris <alexis.morris@clearlinehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Case study draft — request to include short SOC 2 statement and logo

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks again for the great kickoff last week. We're finishing the first draft of Clearline's case study and would like to include a short security statement that references Redwood's SOC 2 attestation. Our marketing team wants to keep the line tight (one sentence) and include the Redwood logo beside the quote.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm whether we can cite: "Redwood Inference maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering security and availability controls." Is that wording OK to publish?
- Are you able to provide a high-resolution logo and any logo usage rules we should follow?

I've attached our current case study excerpt for context (clearline_draft_quote_v1.docx). Please loop in legal if needed.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Nguyen
Director, Product Marketing
Clearline Health

Attachment: clearline_draft_quote_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Case study draft — request to include short SOC 2 statement and logo

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the draft, looks great. Short answers: we can provide a suggested one-line statement and a logo pack, but legal will need to sign off on the exact copy. Looping in Dev (legal) and Stephanie (marketing) so they can confirm acceptable phrasing and send the logo package.

A couple quick notes for your editor:
- If you plan to reference the full attestation (e.g., "full SOC 2 report"), we typically offer a summary PDF but not the complete report publicly.
- We prefer the two-sentence max approach for the body copy and a separate caption that cites the compliance page URL.

I've attached a quick draft line we often approve — feel free to use as a starting point: 
"Redwood Inference maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering security and availability controls; a public summary is available at redwoodinference.com/security."

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: clearline_draft_quote_v1.docx (referenced)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Case study draft — legal guidance on SOC 2 wording and assets

Folks,

I've reviewed Elaine's draft and Hannah's suggested line. Legal is comfortable with a short, factual statement. Recommended approved snippet (legal copy):

"Redwood Inference holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation for security and availability. A non-sensitive summary of the attestation is publicly available; full reports are provided under NDA."

Logo / assets: please send any requested logo usage to marketing@redwoodinference.com — we have a logo pack and basic usage rules.

Restrictions / redaction guidance: do not include any internal control descriptions (tests, control names) in the public case study, and do not publish the full attestation PDF without an executed NDA. We can provide a certificate badge and the redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf as an attachment for publishing.

Attaching: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf, redwood_logo_guidelines.pdf

—Dev
Dev Patel
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (application/pdf); redwood_logo_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Elaine —

Thanks — legal approved the short sentence below. If that works for you, send back a final version of the case study and we'll provide the logo pack and badge.

Approved wording (final candidate):
"Redwood Inference holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation for security and availability; a public summary is available at https://redwoodinference.com/security."

Logo guide and badge will be attached when we receive your approval on final copy. If you want, we can send a short marketing release form (one-page) to capture permissions; I'll include a DocuSign link here: https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABCD-1234-REDWOOD

Best,
Ben

That wording works for us. One small follow-up: can we include the Redwood logo (left aligned) next to the quote? If so, can you confirm the correct logo file to use and any color / spacing rules? Also we'd like to list Redwood as a reference for an upcoming webinar on June 10th — would someone from Redwood be available on a short panel?

I'll route the final draft to you by EOD and sign the release form.

Thanks,
Elaine

"Redwood Inference holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation for security and availability; a public summary is available at https://redwoodinference.com/security."
